$meta.purpose: What the Frontend ships that Storybook does not, with the atomic level of each, so the team can decide what to build next instead of guessing.

method.frontend: Every directory under lotteryplus-frontend-main/src/components with an index.tsx: 458 found. Usage counted by grepping real import statements, not estimated.
method.atomic_level: Derived from composition, per Lark Standard §3: no component imports = atom, 1-2 = molecule, 3+ = organism. A component that imports a store, an API module or the router is marked `data` and is not a design-system component at all.
method.figma: Checked live through the Desktop Bridge on 2026-08-19 by searching every page for a matching COMPONENT or COMPONENT_SET.
method.threshold: Only components with 2 or more real usages are listed — §3.3 share-by-evidence.
